title: AEDYN JAMES - Equal
htmlContent:
AEDYN JAMES's "Equal" is that engaging Hip Hop with edge that people love to hear. His infectious swagger in his approach is most appealing, and makes you a believer for every second of this must hear record. The rhymes are delivered with perfect precision to make it all real for the listener, on this enjoyable track with great appeal to go far.

Everything about this record is commanding, with a hard sound in the production that set the tone perfectly for AEDYN to do his work. When he delivers he delivers with the ultimate conviction in his flow, to show he’s the real deal while he gives impressive lyricism to make this record click in every way for this promising act.
